senses.gloss:
2 वस् उच्छ॑ति pp. उष्ट॑ (—˚) shine, light up, dawn;
bring or drive away (दूरे॑) by shining. C. वासयति cause to shine.
— अप = S. + दूरे॑, extinguish. वि shine abroad, light up. C.
cause to dawn or grow bright. — Cf. व्यु॑ष्ट, व्युषित.

3 वस् व॑स्ते put on, don, enter, assume (an appearance). C.
clothe, dress in, cover with (instr.), M. refl. — अधि put on. अनु
clothe, cover (M. refl.), surround, protect. अभि cover one's self
with (acc.). C. clothe or cover with (instr.). नि put on (over another
garment). परि, प्र, प्रति don. वि change clothes, also = C. put on,
don. सम् dress one's self in (instr.).

वाश् वा॑शति वा॑श˚ते वा॑श्यते वा॑शति वा॑श˚ते
वा॑श्य˚ति pp. वाशित (q.v.) bleat, low, roar, cry (of birds). C.
वाशयति, ˚ते cause to bleat etc.;
 M. sound loudly. I. वावश्यते
howl, croak, sound loudly. अनु & प्रत्यनु low after or in return.
अभि bleat or bellow at (acc.). प्रति the same. सम् (also I.)
bleak etc. (together).

2 वास॑ m. staying (esp. over night), abiding in (loc. or
—˚), abiding-place, house, home, state, condition;
 adj. —˚ living or
dwelling in.

वशंवद a. acknowledging a person's will or power,
obedient or devoted to (—˚).

वशानुग a. following one's own or another's (gen.) will;
subject or obedient to (gen. or —˚).
वशित्व n. self-control or power over (loc.).

वशि॑न् a. having will or power, either self-control or
command over others, ruling, powerful;
 m. ruler, lord of (gen.), f.
वशि॑नी.

वशी॑@कृ A. (M.) make submissive, enthrall, subjugate;
˚भू P.
वशीकार m. वशी˚कृति & वशी˚क्रिया f. the same.
वश्यात्मन् a. whose soul is restrained or controlled.
व॑षट्कृत a. offered with the exclamation Vaṣaṭ.

वसति॑ f. staying (over night), dwelling, living, abode,
home, house, settlement, nest.
वसन्त॑ m. spring (the friend of the god of love).

वासन्त॑ f. ई॑ vernal;
 f. N. of sev. plants.
वसन्तक m. = prec., a man's name.
वसन्ततिलक n. N. of a metre.

वसन्तबन्धु^1 m. the friend of the spring (cf.
वसन्त॑).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: v printed for b..

वसन्तमहोत्सव m. the great spring festival (in
honour of the god of love).
वसन्तश्री f. the beauty of spring.
वसन्तसेन m. आ f. a man's & woman's name.

वसव्य॑ a. wealthy;
 n. wealth (also वस॑व्य).
वसामय f. ई consisting of fat.
वसाय् वसा˚य॑ते dress one's self in (instr.).

वासय् वासय्˚वाति (वासय्˚वा˚ते), pp. वासित (q.v.)
infuse, perfume, make fragrant. — अधि & अनु = S.

व॑सीयंस् (compar.) better than (abl.), more wealthy or
glorious.
वसुदत्त m. आ f. a man's & woman's name.
वसुदे॑य n. bestowing of wealth, liberality.
वसुदेव m. N. of Kṛṣṇa's father etc.
2 वासुदेव a. relating to Kṛṣṇa (cf. prec.).
वसुधा॑ a. yielding good, liberal. f. the earth, land.
वसुधातल n. the surface of the earth.
वसुधाधिप m. lord of the earth, king.
वसुधाधि˚पति m. lord of the earth, king.
वसुधापति m. lord of the earth, king.

व॑सुधिति a. possessing or bestowing wealth;
 f. = seq.

वसुंधर a. containing wealth. f. आ the earth,
land.

व॑सुपति^1 m. (±व॑सूनाम्) lord of wealth or of the
gods (E. of Agni, Indra, etc.).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: 'r' is wrong ('lord of wealth').
वसुम॑य f. ई a consisting in wealth.

वसुरेतस् m. fire or the god of fire (lit. seed of
wealth or of the Vasus).
वसुलक्ष्मी f. N. of a woman.*
वसुव॑नि a. craving or bestowing wealth.
व॑सुवन्त् a. joined with the Vasus.
व॑सुश्रवस् a. having good fame or famed for wealth.
वसुषेण m. E. of Kṛṣṇa and Karṇa.
वसूया॑ (instr. adv.) from desire for good.

वस्तुरचना f. arrangement of a matter, treatment of a
subject.
वस्तूपमा f. a kind of comparison.

व॑स्त्र n. cloth, garment;
 clothes, dress.
वस्त्रपूत a. purified by a cloth.
वस्त्राञ्चल m. the hem of a garment.
वस्त्रान्त m. the end of a garment.
वस्त्रापहारक m. a stealer of clothes.
वस्त्राय् वस्त्रा˚यते be like a garment.
व॑स्यइष्टि f. striving after the highest good.

वाशिता॑ f. a cow desiring the bull (also of other animals &
female, woman i.g.).

वा॑शी f. a pointed knife;
 p. ˚मन्त्.
वासःखण्ड n. piece of cloth, rag.
वा॑सतेय a. deserving or giving shelter.
वासनीय a. intelligible only by deep reflection.

वासपादप m. a tree (serving) as resting place (for
birds).*
वासयष्टि f. pole for a bird to perch on.
वासयितव्य a. to be harboured or lodged.
वासवज m. Indra's son i.e. Arjuna.
वासवदत्ता f. a woman's name, T. of a novel.

1 वा॑सस् n. garment, dress;
 du. under and upper garment.
वासार्थम् adv. to dwell or stay over night.
वासुकि m. N. of a genius & a serpent-king.
वास्तुज्ञान n. art of building, architecture.
वास्तुमध्य s. the centre of a house.
वा॑स्तोष्प॑ति m. the genius of the dwelling.
